'''Paran Am-ris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was before the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] who signed the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

Am-ris was among a delegation of politicians that travelled to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to meet with with the representatives of the Sith Empire to conclude a peace agreement. However, the Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|attacked]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], forcing Am-ris, now interim Supreme Chancellor following [[Berooken]]'s death, to accept the Empire's terms and conditions.

==Biography==
Around [[3653 BBY]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] was among a delegation of politicians, accompanied by two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who traveled to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], on behalf of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with the representatives of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], to conclude a peace agreement. However, it was discovered that the Imperials had threaded this meeting because they secretly planned an attack on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and forced the representatives to accept their terms and conditions. Eventually, he was contacted by Chancellor [[Berooken]] who told him that the planet was attacked by the Empire and therefore cease the negotiations. Sadly, the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] witnessed Berooken's death at the hands of the Sith. [[Darth Baras]], who had been attacked by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]], told the senator that the contract must be signed up at the conditions of the Empire while Coruscant was held hostage. Paran suggested to think about it since the participants were treated unfairly by this approach. Finally, the contract had to be signed, because it didn't connect to Coruscant and the safety of the public.

[[File:Am-Ris_sees_Chancellor_murder.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Senator Am-Ris witnesses the Chancellor's murder.]]
Returning to Coruscant, Am-ris became interim Supreme Chancellor as a result of Berooken's death during the [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]]. Therefore, he had to watch how many system representatives resigned because of the conditions of the contract, including Ambassador [[Mareesh]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. Furthermore, Am-ris had a discussion with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zym]] that the Jedi Temple couldn't be rebuilt from these lack of resources that the Republic had. However, Zym and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gin Lesl]] were allegedly killed in the aftermath, due to another bombing in the Senate. Am-ris received this message with a growing concern, and decided to contact a military base on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The Republic discovered that Zym and Lisl were killed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Braden]] who had apparently also carried out the attack on the Senate. Am-ris was furious and contacted [[Orgus Din]] to find Braden and bring him into custody for [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Republic. He was later replaced by [[Dorian Janarus]] during the same year.
